title: std1 MIDI check
description: A test for core-a4mk2 0.7's standard MIDI events and ev_seq_tick on the Analog Four MKII: a std1 mod that subscribes to ev_midi_in, ev_sysex_in, ev_midi_cc, ev_midi_pc, ev_midi_out, ev_seq_midi and ev_seq_tick, records their calls and last arguments in std_midi (midi.c), and takes one marker CC in ev_midi_in so that ev_midi_cc and stock never see it. Nothing else changes.
